verses.en: And it came to pass, when Samuel was old, that he made his sons judges over Israel.
verses.pt: E aconteceu que havendo Samuel envelhecido, pôs seus filhos por juízes sobre Israel.
verses.en_web: When Samuel was old, he made his sons judges over Israel.
verses.en_bbe: Now when Samuel was old, he made his sons judges over Israel.

verses.en: Now the name of his firstborn was Joel; and the name of his second, Abiah: they were judges in Beer-sheba.
verses.pt: E o nome de seu filho primogênito foi Joel, e o nome do segundo, Abias: foram juízes em Berseba.
verses.en_web: Now the name of his firstborn was Joel; and the name of his second, Abijah. They were judges in Beersheba.
verses.en_bbe: The name of his first son was Joel and the name of his second Abijah: they were judges in Beer-sheba.

verses.en: And his sons walked not in his ways, but turned aside after lucre, and took bribes, and perverted judgment.
verses.pt: Mas não andaram os filhos pelos caminhos de seu pai, antes se inclinaram atrás a ganância, recebendo suborno e pervertendo o direito.
verses.en_web: His sons didn’t walk in his ways, but turned away after dishonest gain, took bribes, and perverted justice.
verses.en_bbe: And his sons did not go in his ways, but moved by the love of money took rewards, and were not upright in judging.

verses.en: Then all the elders of Israel gathered themselves together, and came to Samuel unto Ramah,
verses.pt: Então todos os anciãos de Israel se juntaram, e vieram a Samuel em Ramá,
verses.en_web: Then all the elders of Israel gathered themselves together and came to Samuel to Ramah.
verses.en_bbe: Then all the responsible men of Israel got together and went to Samuel at Ramah,

verses.en: And said unto him, Behold, thou art old, and thy sons walk not in thy ways: now make us a king to judge us like all the nations.
verses.pt: E disseram-lhe: Eis que tu envelheceste, e teus filhos não vão por teus caminhos: portanto, constitui-nos agora um rei que nos julgue, como todas as nações.
verses.en_web: They said to him, “Behold, you are old, and your sons don’t walk in your ways. Now make us a king to judge us like all the nations.”
verses.en_bbe: And said to him, See now, you are old, and your sons do not go in your ways: give us a king now to be our judge, so that we may be like the other nations.

verses.en: But the thing displeased Samuel, when they said, Give us a king to judge us. And Samuel prayed unto the LORD.
verses.pt: E descontentou a Samuel esta palavra que disseram: Dá-nos rei que nos julgue. E Samuel orou ao SENHOR.
verses.en_web: But the thing displeased Samuel, when they said, “Give us a king to judge us.” Samuel prayed to Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: But Samuel was not pleased when they said to him, Give us a king to be our judge. And Samuel made prayer to the Lord.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto Samuel, Hearken unto the voice of the people in all that they say unto thee: for they have not rejected thee, but they have rejected me, that I should not reign over them.
verses.pt: E disse o SENHOR a Samuel: Ouve a voz do povo em tudo o que te disserem: porque não rejeitaram a ti, mas sim a mim me rejeitaram, para que eu não reine sobre eles.
verses.en_web: Yahweh said to Samuel, “Listen to the voice of the people in all that they tell you; for they have not rejected you, but they have rejected me as the king over them.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Samuel, Give ear to the voice of the people and what they say to you: they have not been turned away from you, but they have been turned away from me, not desiring me to be king over them.

verses.en: According to all the works which they have done since the day that I brought them up out of Egypt even unto this day, wherewith they have forsaken me, and served other gods, so do they also unto thee.
verses.pt: Conforme todas as obras que fizeram desde o dia que os tirei do Egito até hoje, que me deixaram e serviram a deuses alheios, assim fazem também contigo.
verses.en_web: According to all the works which they have done since the day that I brought them up out of Egypt even to this day, in that they have forsaken me, and served other gods, so they also do to you.
verses.en_bbe: As they have done from the first, from the day when I took them out of Egypt till this day, turning away from me and worshipping other gods, so now they are acting in the same way to you.

verses.en: Now therefore hearken unto their voice: howbeit yet protest solemnly unto them, and shew them the manner of the king that shall reign over them.
verses.pt: Agora, pois, ouve sua voz: mas protesta contra eles declarando-lhes o direito do rei que há de reinar sobre eles.
verses.en_web: Now therefore listen to their voice. However you shall protest solemnly to them, and shall show them the way of the king who will reign over them.”
verses.en_bbe: Give ear now to their voice: but make a serious protest to them, and give them a picture of the sort of king who will be their ruler.

verses.en: And Samuel told all the words of the LORD unto the people that asked of him a king.
verses.pt: E disse Samuel todas as palavras do SENHOR ao povo que lhe havia pedido rei.
verses.en_web: Samuel told all Yahweh’s words to the people who asked him for a king.
verses.en_bbe: And Samuel said all these words of the Lord to the people who were desiring a king.

verses.en: And he said, This will be the manner of the king that shall reign over you: He will take your sons, and appoint them for himself, for his chariots, and to be his horsemen; and some shall run before his chariots.
verses.pt: Disse, pois: Este será o direito do rei que houver de reinar sobre vós: tomará vossos filhos, e os porá em seus carros, e em seus cavaleiros, para que corram diante de seu carro:
verses.en_web: He said, “This will be the way of the king who shall reign over you: he will take your sons, and appoint them as his servants, for his chariots, and to be his horsemen; and they will run before his chariots.
verses.en_bbe: And he said, This is the sort of king who will be your ruler: he will take your sons and make them his servants, his horsemen, and drivers of his war-carriages, and they will go running before his war-carriages;

verses.en: And he will appoint him captains over thousands, and captains over fifties; and will set them to ear his ground, and to reap his harvest, and to make his instruments of war, and instruments of his chariots.
verses.pt: E se escolherá capitães de mil, e capitães de cinquenta: os porá também a que arem seus campos, e ceifem suas plantações, e a que façam suas armas de guerra, e os equipamentos de seus carros:
verses.en_web: He will appoint them to him for captains of thousands, and captains of fifties; and he will assign some to plow his ground, and to reap his harvest, and to make his instruments of war, and the instruments of his chariots.
verses.en_bbe: And he will make them captains of thousands and of fifties; some he will put to work ploughing and cutting his grain and making his instruments of war and building his war-carriages.

verses.en: And he will take your daughters to be confectionaries, and to be cooks, and to be bakers.
verses.pt: Tomará também vossas filhas para que sejam perfumistas, cozinheiras, e padeiras.
verses.en_web: He will take your daughters to be perfumers, to be cooks, and to be bakers.
verses.en_bbe: Your daughters he will take to be makers of perfumes and cooks and bread-makers.

verses.en: And he will take your fields, and your vineyards, and your oliveyards, even the best of them, and give them to his servants.
verses.pt: Também tomará vossas terras, vossas vinhas, e vossos bons olivais, e os dará a seus servos.
verses.en_web: He will take your fields, your vineyards, and your olive groves, even their best, and give them to his servants.
verses.en_bbe: He will take your fields and your vine-gardens and your olive-gardens, all the best of them, and give them to his servants.

verses.en: And he will take the tenth of your seed, and of your vineyards, and give to his officers, and to his servants.
verses.pt: Ele tomará o dízimo de vossas sementes e vossas vinhas, para dar a seus eunucos e a seus servos.
verses.en_web: He will take one tenth of your seed, and of your vineyards, and give it to his officers, and to his servants.
verses.en_bbe: He will take a tenth of your seed and of the fruit of your vines and give it to his servants.

verses.en: And he will take your menservants, and your maidservants, and your goodliest young men, and your asses, and put them to his work.
verses.pt: Ele tomará vossos servos, e vossas servas, e vossos bons rapazes, e vossos asnos, e com eles fará suas obras.
verses.en_web: He will take your male servants, your female servants, your best young men, and your donkeys, and assign them to his own work.
verses.en_bbe: He will take your men-servants and your servant-girls, and the best of your oxen and your asses and put them to his work.

verses.en: He will take the tenth of your sheep: and ye shall be his servants.
verses.pt: Tomará o dízimo também do vosso rebanho, e sereis seus servos.
verses.en_web: He will take one tenth of your flocks; and you will be his servants.
verses.en_bbe: He will take a tenth of your sheep: and you will be his servants.

verses.en: And ye shall cry out in that day because of your king which ye shall have chosen you; and the LORD will not hear you in that day.
verses.pt: E clamareis aquele dia por causa de vosso rei que vos havereis escolhido, mas o SENHOR não vos ouvirá naquele dia.
verses.en_web: You will cry out in that day because of your king whom you will have chosen for yourselves; and Yahweh will not answer you in that day.”
verses.en_bbe: Then you will be crying out because of your king whom you have taken for yourselves; but the Lord will not give you an answer in that day.

verses.en: Nevertheless the people refused to obey the voice of Samuel; and they said, Nay; but we will have a king over us;
verses.pt: Porém o povo não quis ouvir a voz de Samuel; antes disseram: Não, mas sim que haverá rei sobre nós:
verses.en_web: But the people refused to listen to the voice of Samuel; and they said, “No; but we will have a king over us,
verses.en_bbe: But the people gave no attention to the voice of Samuel; and they said, No, but we will have a king over us,

verses.en: That we also may be like all the nations; and that our king may judge us, and go out before us, and fight our battles.
verses.pt: E nós seremos também como todas as nações, e nosso rei nos governará, e sairá diante de nós, e fará nossas guerras.
verses.en_web: that we also may be like all the nations, and that our king may judge us, and go out before us, and fight our battles.”
verses.en_bbe: So that we may be like the other nations, and so that our king may be our judge and go out before us to war.

verses.en: And Samuel heard all the words of the people, and he rehearsed them in the ears of the LORD.
verses.pt: E ouviu Samuel todas as palavras do povo, e referiu-as aos ouvidos do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: Samuel heard all the words of the people, and he rehearsed them in the ears of Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Then Samuel, after hearing all the people had to say, went and gave an account of it to the Lord.

verses.en: And the LORD said to Samuel, Hearken unto their voice, and make them a king. And Samuel said unto the men of Israel, Go ye every man unto his city.
verses.pt: E o SENHOR disse a Samuel: Ouve sua voz, e põe rei sobre eles. Então disse Samuel aos homens de Israel: Ide-vos cada um à sua cidade.
verses.en_web: Yahweh said to Samuel, “Listen to their voice, and make them a king.” Samuel said to the men of Israel, “Everyone go to your own city.”
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Samuel, Give ear to their voice and make a king for them. Then Samuel said to the men of Israel, Let every man go back to his town.
